idempotency.name: Save / duplicate / concurrent requests use one existing encrypted record

results.name: Fresh process, fresh login, exact existing encrypted snapshot reopen
Fresh process does not grant foreign account saved history access

revocation.name: Revoked reviewer loses access without deletion of historical payload

retention: 7/30 days remain R4 LOCAL_POLICY_PROPOSAL_NOT_FORMAL_ADMISSION; no permanent retention invented
concurrentWrites: R4 reservation plus encrypted native store; R5 concurrent same-request test passes. Cross-process pending requests remain fail-closed; no automatic takeover or recovery approval.
recovery: Original source pins preserved; pending interruption requires an audited owner recovery decision. Existing valid completed snapshot reopens after process restart.
revoke: Fresh native authorization rechecked; deny new reads, do not delete potential retention-required history.
cleanup: No production cleanup, retention expiry deletion or backup deletion policy approved; no deletion performed
